name: push_left_step
prompt: a person standing is pushed from the left side, takes a quick step to the right and catches their balance with their arms

name: push_right_step
prompt: a person standing is pushed from the right side, takes a quick step to the left and catches their balance with their arms

name: push_back_step
prompt: a person standing is pushed from behind, stumbles one step forward and catches their balance, arms reaching forward

name: push_front_step
prompt: a person standing is pushed in the chest, steps backward and regains balance, arms coming forward

name: push_left_sway
prompt: a person gets a light shove from the left, sways and shifts their weight, arms lifting out briefly, then stands still

name: push_right_sway
prompt: a person gets a light shove from the right, sways and shifts their weight, arms lifting out briefly, then stands still

name: walk_bump_left
prompt: a person walking forward is bumped from the left, stumbles sideways, recovers their balance and keeps walking

name: walk_bump_right
prompt: a person walking forward is bumped from the right, stumbles sideways, recovers their balance and keeps walking

name: walk_trip
prompt: a person walking forward trips, takes two quick steps and catches their balance with their arms, then keeps walking

name: windmill_recover
prompt: a person loses their balance backward and swings their arms to recover, then stands upright

name: lean_recover_side
prompt: a person leans too far to the side, steps out with one foot and raises the opposite arm to recover balance

name: slip_recover
prompt: a person slips slightly, bends their knees, spreads their arms and steadies themselves
